fresh_ledger_rule: Config::recommended is one replica with the population search off, and each run starts from Ledger::new. All eight cells use that preset, so all eight are fresh-ledger default trajectories. Only an adaptive, replica-id filtered search is allowed to move.
rule: PASS only when the paired runs are complete and B has no cell with fewer hits at two-sided Fisher p<0.05 and no cell with a higher hit-call median at two-sided Mann-Whitney p<0.05 above the A/A' bootstrap band
